summary: Catch Rate & Minlucks now shows attraction rates and an overall catch rate for your current setup. There's also a new Custom Trap Selector to rearrange and hide the blocks under your trap, and a bunch more you can add to the top menu. Favorite Setups has an updated interface, with setups being able to be set for specific locations or regions and a nicer editing experience. Mice and item popups are also slightly redesigned and show more info. Happy hunting!

details.title: New
items: Better Item Details: See which mice drop an item and their drop chances
Better Maps: Added a Beta option to quick send SUPER|brie+ to the Maptain from the map sidebar
Better Mice: See what a mouse drops, and your catch count and crown in the redesigned mouse view
Better Shops: Costs now update as you enter a quantity
Catch Rate & Minlucks: Added attraction rates, sortable columns, and an overall catch rate
Custom Menu: Added Favorite Setups, Journal Logs, and Keyboard Shortcuts as top menu options
Custom Menu: Added a HUD toggle, Spring Egg Hunt Helper, and uncaught mice at your location as top menu options
Custom Menu: You can now customize the Info bar, and the editor is easier to use on mobile
Custom Trap Selector: Reorder and hide the blocks under your trap
Dark Mode: Added a Beta option to tint journal entries with event and location colors
Dark Mode Color Schemes: Added an experimental option for choosing dark and light color schemes presets with matching Horn/Shield/HUD colors
Favorite Setups: Redesigned the list and editor, and setups can now be saved for a whole region

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Better Maps: Completed goals are grouped in the Goals tab, and attraction rates show by default
Better Marketplace: Click a row in the listings or history tabs to open the item
Better UI: Dialogs now scroll into view if they open offscreen
Item Abbreviation Search is now on for everyone, so searching "ESB" finds Empowered SUPER|brie+
Collapsed sections now stay collapsed across views and page loads
MouseHunt Improved now loads more reliably when something fails to load
Lots of smaller fixes and style tweaks
